title: EndDeviceCapability
description: Inherent capabilities of an end device (i.e., the functions it supports).

onRequestRead.description: True if on request read function is supported.

connectDisconnect.description: True if connect and disconnect function is supported.

reverseFlow.description: True if reverse flow function is supported.

pulseOutput.description: True if device produces pulse outputs.

electricMetering.description: True if electric metering function is supported.

pricingInfo.description: True if pricing information is supported.

relaysProgramming.description: True if relays programming function is supported.

waterMetering.description: True if water metering function is supported.

outageHistory.description: True if outage history function is supported.

communication.description: True if communication function is supported.

pressureCompensation.description: True if device performs pressure compensation for metered quantities.

gasMetering.description: True if gas metering function is supported.

metrology.description: True if metrology function is supported.

temperatureCompensation.description: True if device performs temperature compensation for metered quantities.

autonomousDst.description: True if autonomous DST (daylight saving time) function is supported.

superCompressibilityCompensation.description: True if device performs super compressibility compensation for metered quantities.

demandResponse.description: True if demand response function is supported.

textMessage.description: True if the displaying of text messages is supported.
